title: MetadataModel
description: A single record of metadata that is associated to one entity

containsPersonalInformation.description: When this is set to true, the metadata will be obfuscated during export

createDateTime.description: When was this field value entered

createUserId.description: The user id of the user who entered this field value

itemId.description: The ID of the entity to which this value is associated

metadataFieldId.description: The metadata field ID for this value

metadataFieldName.description: The field name for this metadata value

metadataFieldSectionId.description: The section ID in which this metadata value resides

metadataFieldSectionName.description: The section name in which this metadata value resides

metadataFieldTypeId.description: The ID for the field type in which this metadata value resides

metadataFieldTypeName.description: The field name in which this metadata value resides

metadataItemDataId.description: The sequence ID for this specific metadata value record

metadataTypeName.description: The type name in which this metadata value resides

sortOrder.description: Not currently utilized, but the sort order for the metadata

valueBit.description: The value when the metadata field is a boolean

valueDateTime.description: The value when the metadata field is a date

valueInt.description: The value when the metadata field is a user

valueNumber.description: The value when the metadata field is a number

valueString.description: The value when the metadata field is a string

valueUserDisplayName.description: The user display name when the metadata field is a user type
